review:
SUMMARY: Builder refactoring for domain reload tests introduces a behavioral regression in operation attribute handling.
POINTS:
- [testsuite/shared/src/main/java/org/jboss/as/test/integration/domain/management/util/DomainLifecycleUtil.java:455] `restart-servers` is now always explicitly set to `true` instead of being omitted when `null`, potentially altering Domain Controller behavior for tests that previously relied on the attribute being absent — fix: revert `restartServers` to a nullable `Boolean` and guard the operation attribute assignment with a null check to preserve original omission semantics.

suspicions.observation: In the old code, `restartServers` was `Boolean` and only set in the operation when non-null: `if (restartServers != null) { op.get(ModelDescriptionConstants.RESTART_SERVERS).set(restartServers); }`. In the new code, `restartServers` defaults to `true` and is always set: `op.get(ModelDescriptionConstants.RESTART_SERVERS).set(parameters.restartServers);`. Callers like `AdminOnlyModeTestCase` previously called `reload("primary", null, true)` which omitted the `restart-servers` attribute entirely, but now the builder defaults `restartServers=true` and always includes it in the operation.
suspicions.suspected_bug: The behavioral change where `restart-servers` attribute is now always explicitly set to `true` instead of being omitted when `null` could cause different behavior if the Domain Controller treats an omitted attribute differently from an explicit `true` value. Tests relying on the attribute being absent will now send `restart-servers=true` explicitly.

bugs.evidence: testsuite/shared/src/main/java/org/jboss/as/test/integration/domain/management/util/DomainLifecycleUtil.java:477 - ReloadParameters defaults restartServers=true (primitive boolean) and the reload() method at line 450 always sets op.get(RESTART_SERVERS).set(parameters.restartServers), whereas the old code only set it when the nullable Boolean was non-null.
